description: This file declares functions for pointwise tensor operations such as computeSign, computeOneOperand, computeTwoOperand, and others, which generate tensor computations for various operators in the Torch JIT Tensorexpr library.

methods.name: computeSign
methods.description: Computes the sign of a tensor input, producing an output tensor based on the inputs.

methods.name: computeOneOperand
methods.description: Generates a tensor computation for a unary operation specified by the innerExpr function.

methods.name: computeTwoOperand
methods.description: Creates a binary tensor operation with specified function innerExpr.

methods.name: computeTwoOperandWithAlpha
methods.description: Creates a binary tensor operation with an additional 'alpha' parameter, using innerExpr.

methods.name: computeConditionWithTwoOperand
methods.description: Creates a tensor computation for a conditional operation based on two inputs.

methods.name: computeThreeOperand
methods.description: Generates a tensor operation involving three operands.

methods.name: computeFourOperand
methods.description: Generates a tensor operation involving four operands.

methods.name: computeNoop
methods.description: Represents a no-operation tensor computation, typically passing inputs directly.

methods.name: computeScalar
methods.description: Generates a scalar tensor computation based on a binary function innerExpr.
